changelog:
instagram-reel-to-pdp-clip v0.1.1

- Adds detailed SKILL.md documentation outlining workflow, scope, input requirements, and execution instructions.
- Clarifies routing logic for related job types (PDP sets, hotel amenities, assembly steps, generic stills).
- Defines strict steps for handling inputs, product still inspection, Instagram Reel lookup, and billing.
- Specifies safe default behaviors and requirements for animated video generation.
- Explains recovery, delivery, and strict use of the bundled MCP client for all operations.
- Documents automatic update process and installation safeguards.
summary: Instagram product video is one product detail video per product still after reading a competitor Reel. Use this Instagram PDP clip studio for a product page video and a Reel-to-PDP clip from the same still list.
